# Audio Transcription Studio

> Free offline desktop audio and video transcription app for macOS and Windows powered by Tauri 2, Rust, React, and whisper.cpp.

- Repository: https://github.com/voice-to-text/audio-transcription-service
- Overview: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/
- Guides Directory: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/guides.html

## Topic Pages
- Offline audio transcription app without internet: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/offline-audio-transcription.html
- Whisper desktop app with Watch Folder and player: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/whisper-desktop-app.html
- Private speech to text with zero cloud uploads: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/private-speech-to-text-no-cloud.html
- Convert MP3 files to text offline: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/mp3-to-text-offline.html
- WAV to text transcription on desktop: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/wav-to-text-transcription.html
- Convert M4A voice memos to text offline: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/m4a-voice-memo-to-text.html
- Extract text and subtitles from MP4 video: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/mp4-video-to-text-subtitles.html

- Generate WebVTT captions from audio: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/audio-to-vtt-webvtt-captions.html
- Click timestamps to verify spoken audio: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/timestamped-transcript-player.html
- Batch transcription queue that survives restarts: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/batch-audio-transcription-queue.html
- Skip duplicate audio files automatically: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/duplicate-file-protection-sha256.html
- Russian, English, and mixed speech recognition: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/russian-english-speech-to-text.html
- Handle background noise, multiple speakers, and silence: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/noisy-audio-and-silence-vad.html
